newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Toco says Premier Chemicals "not for sale".
newsitem.headline: Toco says Premier Chemicals "not for sale".

text.p: South African industrial group Toco Holdings said on Tuesday that its Premier Chemicals unit was not for sale.
In a private placing last week rival Amlac/Trademaster said it was interested in buying firms like Premier, Toco said.
"Premier Chemicals is not for sale and no discussions have been held with any company in this regard," said Toco joint managing director Michael Todd.
Premier makes paints and industrial chemicals and in the year to March 31, 1996, contributed 26 percent of the group's net profit before tax of 32.63 million rand.
